title: Lesson 47 mixed-option relational nounstems technical proof

groups.title: tzalan and huic options one and two
groups.proposal: Let tzalan and huic alternate between possessive and integrated-matrix formations while preserving varietal, compound, negative, affective, and directional Source restrictions.
groups.readingJob: Show relational family, selected formation, possessor or embedded Source, contextual direction, and boundary.
groups.decisionSplit: Formation and licensed Source kind are genuine choices; contextual translation is derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not offer connective-t option three to these families.

groups.title: ca and icpac options one and three
groups.proposal: Let ca and icpac alternate between possessive and connective-t linked formations, preserving compound, temporal, modifier, and Source-history constraints.
groups.readingJob: Show possessor or linked Source, connective boundary, contextual function, and retained Source history.
groups.decisionSplit: Only option one or three is available for these families.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not expose the unlicensed integrated-matrix option two.

groups.title: tech three-option system
groups.proposal: Compose tech through possessive, integrated-matrix, or connective-t linked formation with exact nounstem or compound Source and licensed boundary assimilation.
groups.readingJob: Show selected option, Source kind, matrix, connective, assimilation, and continuation availability.
groups.decisionSplit: All three formations are choices only because the tech owner licenses them.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer a formation from the final written shape.

groups.title: tlan three-option system
groups.proposal: Compose tlan through its three licensed formations while retaining body-part, compound, affective, directional, and contextual Source distinctions.
groups.readingJob: Show formation, Source family, body-part or compound structure, affective path, and directional restriction.
groups.decisionSplit: Formation and licensed Source family are genuine choices; interpretation remains contextual.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not flatten body-part and compound histories into a raw stem.

groups.title: pan three-option and continuation system
groups.proposal: Compose pan through possessive, integrated-matrix, or connective-t formation while preserving number-connective, body-part, nepan, direction, metaphor, normal-subject, and verbal-continuation facts.
groups.readingJob: Show formation, Source history, number connective, subject behavior, direction, metaphor, and continuation target.
groups.decisionSplit: Only owner-licensed Source and continuation alternatives are selectable.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not treat every huan-like sequence as a conjunctor or every pan form as interchangeable.

groups.title: Associated-entity formation
groups.proposal: Consume an exact compound relational Source, replace final co or c with the canonical silent variant where required, and attach associated-entity ca without creating a gentilic route.
groups.readingJob: Show upstream relational Result, final-boundary replacement, ca attachment, outer state, and non-gentilic identity.
groups.decisionSplit: The relational Source is chosen upstream; boundary replacement is automatic.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer associated entity from a copied surface or classify it as gentilic.

groups.title: Direct and associated-entity pertinency
groups.proposal: Build pertinency from either an exact direct relational Source or an exact associated-entity Result, preserving outer state independence and source provenance.
groups.readingJob: Show direct or associated Source route, upstream identity, yo attachment, outer state, and possessor independence.
groups.decisionSplit: Source route is selectable only when an exact canonical Result is available.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not reconstruct the Source from surface segments or let the embedded possessor control outer state.
